	hidden_effect = {
		remove_character_modifier = LR_estates_1_modifier

		remove_character_modifier = LR_estates_3_modifier

			limit = { has_variable = LR_estates }

		if = { limit = { var:LR_estates = 5 } add_character_modifier = LR_estates_5_modifier }
		}
	}
}

# Character: estates grow one step (up to Major)
LR_estates_grow_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = LR_estates }
		change_variable = { name = LR_estates add = 1 }
		clamp_variable = { name = LR_estates max = 5 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = LR_estates value = 1 }
	}
	LR_estates_refresh_effect = yes
}

# Character: estates are gone
LR_estates_clear_effect = {
	remove_variable = LR_estates
	LR_estates_refresh_effect = yes
}

# Character: hand the estates to $HEIR$ (keeps the larger of the two)
LR_estates_pass_effect = {
	save_scope_as = LR_estates_giver
	$HEIR$ = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_variable = LR_estates }
					var:LR_estates < scope:LR_estates_giver.var:LR_estates
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = LR_estates value = scope:LR_estates_giver.var:LR_estates }
			LR_estates_refresh_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

# Ruler (yearly): courtiers with money buy more estates (LI liestates.4)
LR_estates_yearly_effect = {
	every_courtier = {
		limit = {
			LR_can_hold_estates_trigger = yes
			LR_estates_can_grow_trigger = yes
			gold >= LR_estates_buy_cost_value
			OR = {
				has_trait = ambitious

				LR_has_estates_trigger = yes

			chance = 25
